name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Getting AI from a promising pilot to something an operations team relies on is the part of this role I'd own best. I deploy AI in production for clients today: LLM calls inside automated workflows, with rubric-based grading of the output so nothing reaches a customer unchecked. The hard part is rarely the model. It's getting the people who run the operation to trust the output and change how they work.

That's been my career. At Accelo I advised C-suite leaders on operational system design and built the sequenced implementation plans their teams executed. At Wix I ran up to 25 deployments at once at 110% of my implementation target, and at Birdeye I used usage data to catch adoption gaps early and retained all but one of 15 to 20 partners.

To be direct: I haven't worked with industrial customers or deployed predictive maintenance or APM platforms, and my accounts have been mid-market rather than enterprise. If you're open to someone who brings the adoption and AI side and learns the plant side, I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
